_meta.description: 用户可见的 CardKit 卡片文案（多语言）。默认 zh；LOCALE 环境变量切换（zh|en）。注意：这里只放卡片 chrome 文案（标题/按钮/面板/状态/失败提示），不包含 agent 在答案文本里 emit、由网关解析的 marker（供研发复核 / 你可能还想问 / 需要你确认）——那些是 system.md 的契约，不在此。占位符用 {name} 形式。

zh.card.panel.evidence.title: 供研发复核（点开看代码出处）
zh.card.footer.followup.heading: 继续追问：
zh.card.footer.followup.replyHint: 想继续追问，**回复本条消息**即可（会带上本轮的上下文）。
zh.card.footer.followup.replyHintWithButton: 想问的不在上面？**直接回复本条消息**接着问即可（会带上本轮的上下文）。
zh.card.status.queued: 排队中（正在等待上一个问题分析完成）
zh.card.action.narrow.prompt: 只聚焦其中一个最关键的点，简要回答：{question}
zh.card.feedback.reason.prompt: 哪里没帮上？（可选，点一下）
zh.card.reasoning.synthesized: 已检索并查阅了相关代码，据此得出上面的结论（点开「供研发复核」可看精确出处）。
zh.msg.fail.modelAccess: 模型访问未开通：请在 AWS Bedrock 控制台为该模型开通 Model access（global.* 跨区域推理需在相关区域分别开通），开通后即可正常回答。
zh.msg.fail.backend: 查询失败（后端不可用或取证中断），请稍后重试；若持续失败请转研发。
zh.msg.fail.toolcallLeak: 这次没能得出可靠答案（取证过程未正常完成）。请再问一次试试；若反复如此，把问题发给研发排查。
zh.msg.turnCapped.withBody: *（分析步骤较多，未在限定步数内完成；以上为已得到的部分结论，建议把问题缩小后再问，例如只问某一个符号 / 某一处影响）*
zh.msg.turnCapped.noBody: 这个问题分析步骤较多，未在限定步数内得出结论。请把问题缩小（如只问某一个符号 / 某一处影响）后重试。
zh.msg.timeout: 分析超时，请缩小问题范围后重试。
zh.msg.timeout.withBody: *（分析超时，未在限定时间内跑完；以上为已得到的部分结论，建议把问题缩小后再问，例如只问某一个符号 / 某一处影响）*
zh.msg.serviceError: 暂时无法回答（服务异常），请稍后重试：

en.card.panel.evidence.title: For dev review (tap for code locations)
en.card.footer.followup.heading: Continue asking:
en.card.footer.followup.replyHint: To follow up, **reply to this message** (it carries this turn's context).
en.card.footer.followup.replyHintWithButton: Not listed above? **Just reply to this message** to ask anything else (it carries this turn's context).
en.card.status.queued: Queued (waiting for the previous question to finish)…
en.card.action.narrow.prompt: Focus on the single most important point and answer briefly: {question}
en.card.reasoning.synthesized: Searched and read the relevant code, and reached the conclusion above (tap "For dev review" for exact locations).
en.msg.fail.modelAccess: Model access not enabled: enable Model access for this model in the AWS Bedrock console (global.* cross-region inference must be enabled per region), then it will work.
en.msg.fail.backend: Query failed (backend unavailable or retrieval interrupted). Please retry shortly; if it keeps failing, escalate to dev.
en.msg.fail.toolcallLeak: Couldn't produce a reliable answer this time (retrieval didn't complete). Please ask again; if it keeps happening, send the question to dev.
en.msg.turnCapped.withBody: *(Many analysis steps; didn't finish within the step limit. The above is the partial result — try narrowing the question, e.g. ask about one symbol / one impact.)*
en.msg.turnCapped.noBody: This question took many analysis steps and didn't conclude within the step limit. Please narrow it (e.g. ask about one symbol / one impact) and retry.
en.msg.aborted.withBody: *(Stopped; the above is what was generated.)*
en.msg.timeout: Analysis timed out. Please narrow the question and retry.
en.msg.timeout.withBody: *(Analysis timed out before finishing. The above is the partial result — try narrowing the question, e.g. ask about one symbol / one impact.)*
en.msg.serviceError: Temporarily unable to answer (service error). Please retry shortly:
